qualifies_reason: Independent London fashion biannual (the women's title of the same publisher as 10 Men) with Issue 77 on newsstands since 18 September 2026.
what_it_is: 10 Magazine is a London womenswear fashion title that appears twice a year, timed to the collections, with a themed trio of words per issue and a dozen or so alternative covers. It runs long photographic fashion stories commissioned around individual luxury houses, interviews with designers, models and musicians, and (for Issue 77) a separate watches and jewellery supplement. It is for readers who follow high fashion imagery and the luxury houses closely.
